name: ATM Withdrawal Request V 03
definition: The ATMWithdrawalRequest message is sent by an ATM to an acquirer or its agent to request the approval of a withdrawal transaction at an ATM.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMWithdrawalRequest.name: ATM Withdrawal Request
ATMWithdrawalRequest.definition: Information related to the request of a withdrawal transaction from an ATM.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
